comparison_boundaries.BE_fixed_W_I: diagonal scale tangent versus nonzero skew off-diagonal pair tangent
comparison_boundaries.common_Q: one member-common Q can be absorbed into free W; route-specific Q generally cannot all be absorbed into one W
comparison_boundaries.common_components_limit: learned diagonals and W/multiple nonlinear sites prevent a whole-network noncontainment or quality theorem
comparison_boundaries.node_aggregation: node-shared Q commutes with fixed scalar channelwise aggregation; not a guarantee for feature-dependent attention or full nonlinear/residual network
comparison_boundaries.rank1_LoRA_plain_SGD_fixed_base: delta A=-eta G q q^T at unit incoming norm, a different constrained direction from Householder
comparison_boundaries.rank1_vs_pair: rank-one stretch can violate orthogonal Gram; nontrivial full-rank-base plane rotation correction has rank2, excluding rank1 addition relative to that fixed base; isolated families incomparable
comparison_boundaries.scalar_gauge: rescaling r/s Jacobian columns does not create off-diagonal effective-map tangent freedom; pair can
comparison_boundaries.zero_output_rank1_LoRA: b=0,a=q -> delta A=delta b q^T, d live outgoing coordinates; grad_a=0 initially

component_law.diagonal_component: existing r/s retained and learned in all conditions; coherent unit starts
component_law.normal_parameters: additional two separate d-vectors per route/site; equal values initially, never aliased objects
component_law.outside_bias: retained native b_shared is outside output diagonal; unchanged; additive b is a different private vector

cost_formulas.extra_forward_action: two dot products plus vector subtraction stages per reflection pair; O(M sum_sites N_site d_site)
cost_formulas.live_graph_trajectories: unchanged M full routes, not shared away
cost_formulas.training_states: normal parameters, gradients, first/second Adam moments all paid; existing diagonal/native states remain

global_pair_family.additive_rank2_decomposition: Q-I=-2q1 q1^T-2q2 q2^T+4(q1^T q2)q1 q2^T; W(Q-I) has rank<=2
global_pair_family.geometric_action: rotation in one two-plane (identity at degenerate pair)

identity_tangent.d2: all q give the same one-dimensional skew tangent; different seed directions do not change its span
identity_tangent.normal_sign_change: q and -q produce same H and tangent family
identity_tangent.normalized_normal_changes: a=(I-q q^T)delta_u1; b=(I-q q^T)delta_u2 at unit raw radius
identity_tangent.predictive_dimension: at most d-1; W nullspace, input span, normalizations/downstream Jacobians may reduce or erase it

loss_pullback_at_unit_start.G: dL/dA includes actual own-loss reduction and all network pullbacks
loss_pullback_at_unit_start.effective_A_first_order: delta A=delta W+W delta Q at initial unit diagonals, plus common diagonal terms if updated; shared W uses old-state gradients
native_Adam_boundaries: normalized forward H remains orthogonal if u stays nonzero
ordinary Adam is not rotationally equivariant
opposite raw gradients at identity do not imply this SGD formula under Adam
loss_pullback_at_unit_start.projection_identity: Writing S=C-C^T and P=q q^T, Pi_Tq(C)=(SP+PS)/2; plain SGD deltaQ=-16eta Pi_Tq(C)+O(eta^2) for two unit-radius raw normals
loss_pullback_at_unit_start.raw_radius: H(cu)=H(u), but raw radius rescales the Jacobian/optimizer geometry; equal unit radius prescribed at start

norm_statements.complete_A_with_diagonals: A A^T=D_s W Q D_r^2 Q^T W^T D_s; not generally equal to baseline Gram
norm_statements.fixed_W_rotation_only: (WQ)(WQ)^T=W W^T, with same singular values/rank/Frobenius norm
norm_statements.live_W: shared W continues to change row Gram and spectra

verification: manual symbolic chain rule, orthogonality and plane-rotation dimension; written d=128 parameter arithmetic only; no model import, arrays, fixture or job
